trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for REAL_ESTATE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- booking_amount: Handle token and booking amounts, allotment status and refund requests within RERA rules.
- site_visit_scheduling: Qualify a lead against real inventory and book a site visit with a named executive.

Business context:
- booking_amount: Indian developer and brokerage contact centre. Callers respond to listings, ask about availability, price and possession, and book site visits. Price and possession commitments are regulated claims.
- site_visit_scheduling: Indian developer and brokerage contact centre. Callers respond to listings, ask about availability, price and possession, and book site visits. Price and possession commitments are regulated claims.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [booking_amount]
  - Deduction truth: The deduction and refundable amount must be the ones the eligibility tool returns.
  - Eligibility first: No refund may be initiated before check_refund_eligibility has returned eligible.
  - No timeline promises: The processing time quoted must be the tool's, never an assurance of sooner.
  - Confirmed allotment: A confirmed allotment follows the agreement's cancellation terms, not the token policy.
  [site_visit_scheduling]
  - Price truth: Only a price returned by check_inventory may be quoted. No 'starting from' figure the tool did not return.
  - Possession claims: Possession may only be stated as the quarter the inventory record carries, never as a promise.
  - RERA disclosure: The RERA id must be stated when a project is discussed, when the tool returns one.
  - No investment advice: The agent must not advise whether a property is a good investment or predict appreciation.

Tools available to you (7): check_inventory, check_refund_eligibility, initiate_refund, lookup_booking, lookup_lead, schedule_site_visit, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: mr-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: check_inventory
model_visible_tools.description: List unsold units in a project with carpet area, floor, price and possession quarter.

model_visible_tools.name: check_refund_eligibility
model_visible_tools.description: Apply the cancellation policy to a booking and return what is refundable.

model_visible_tools.name: initiate_refund
model_visible_tools.description: Start a refund against a cancelled booking.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_booking
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve a booking's unit, amounts paid, allotment state and cancellation window.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_lead
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve a lead's stated budget, preferred configuration and prior visits.

model_visible_tools.name: schedule_site_visit
model_visible_tools.description: Book a site visit slot with an assigned sales executive.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Challenges a figure at least once and asks how it was arrived at.
Does not accept the first explanation without a reason.
Is willing to proceed once given an evidenced answer.
Becomes terse when the agent cannot substantiate a claim.

steps.purpose: Initiate outbound call and state the reason.
steps.text: नमस्कार, मी property desk वरून बोलत आहे. तुम्ही उद्याच्या site visit साठी request केली होती, त्याबद्दल मला बोलायचं आहे.

steps.purpose: Acknowledge the call and provide reference number.
steps.text: हो, मला मेसेज आला होता. माझा reference number LD-1010 आहे.

steps.purpose: Lookup lead details using the provided reference number.

steps.text: धन्यवाद. पुढे जाण्यापूर्वी verification साठी तुमचं नाव आणि पिनकोड सांगू शकाल का?

steps.purpose: Provide verification factors with a simulated STT error.
steps.text: हो, माझं नाव समीर आहे आणि पिनकोड ४११०४५ आहे.

steps.purpose: Acknowledge verification and ask which project the visit is for.
steps.text: धन्यवाद, verification पूर्ण झालं आहे. तुम्ही Bengaluru मध्ये 3BHK पाहत आहात. तुमची visit कोणत्या project साठी आहे?

steps.purpose: Provide project name and ask for exact price.
steps.text: मला Green Meadows ला visit करायची आहे, पण तिथे 3BHK ची price काय आहे? मला exact price सांगा, मगच मी confirm करेन.

steps.purpose: Check inventory for the requested project and configuration.
Provide the exact price, possession, and RERA ID based on the inventory.
steps.text: Green Meadows चा RERA ID PRJ-123 आहे. सध्या ५ व्या मजल्यावर १२०० sqft carpet area चा 3BHK उपलब्ध आहे. त्याची price १,१५,००,००० रुपये आहे आणि possession Q4 2025 मध्ये मिळेल.

steps.purpose: Challenge the quoted price as a sceptical disputer.
steps.text: १ कोटी १५ लाख? एवढी price कशी काय? मला तर आधी कोणीतरी १ कोटी १० लाख सांगितलं होतं. तुम्ही नक्की बरोबर सांगत आहात का? मला reason सांगा.

steps.purpose: Reiterate the system price without making unsupported guarantees.
steps.text: माझ्या सिस्टीममध्ये सध्या ५ व्या मजल्यावरील युनिटची price १,१५,००,००० रुपयेच दिसत आहे. मी फक्त सिस्टीममधील inventory नुसारच price सांगू शकतो. आधीच्या price बद्दल मला माहिती नाही.

steps.purpose: Accept the explanation and ask to schedule the visit.
steps.text: अच्छा, ठीक आहे. जर सिस्टीममध्ये तेच आहे तर ठीक आहे. मग उद्याची visit दुपारची फिक्स करा.

steps.purpose: Schedule the site visit for tomorrow afternoon.
Confirm the scheduled visit to the user.
steps.text: तुमची उद्या दुपारची visit confirm झाली आहे. तुमचे executive Suresh असतील आणि visit reference VR-999 आहे. काही अडचण असल्यास आम्हाला नक्की सांगा.

ir.terminal_condition: Site visit scheduled with a reference, an executive and a slot.

variant_findings.reason: The agent grounds its responses entirely on the tool outputs, accurately quoting the RERA ID, floor, square footage, price, possession quarter, executive name, and visit reference without making unsupported claims.
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding

variant_findings.reason: The reference number 'LD-1010' provided by the user in e2 is successfully recalled and reused in multiple subsequent tool calls (e3, e7, e17) without the agent asking for it again.
variant_findings.label: General Instruction Following > Long-term memory or slot/state recall in multi-turn conversation > Slot Value Recall

issues.detail: In e14, the user claims that someone previously quoted them a lower price ('मला तर आधी कोणीतरी १ कोटी १० लाख सांगितलं होतं'). This directly triggers the escalation condition 'Caller alleges a commitment a previous executive made that the record does not show.' However, the agent does not escalate the call and instead proceeds to book the visit.
issues.repair_instruction: Rephrase the user's utterance in e14 so they challenge the price and ask for a reason (to satisfy the sceptical_disputer persona) without alleging a prior commitment from an executive. For example, they could say they expected it to be cheaper based on market rates. Adjust the assistant's response in e15 and the subsequent turns to successfully schedule the site visit.

verification.summary: The conversation successfully demonstrates Tool Output Grounding and Slot Value Recall. However, it fails because the user's dialogue explicitly triggers a defined escalation condition (alleging a prior commitment from an executive), but the agent ignores this and proceeds to schedule the visit instead of escalating. A suffix repair is needed to change the user's objection so it doesn't trigger the escalation condition.

variant_findings.reason: The agent strictly bases the project details (RERA ID, floor, carpet area, price, possession) on the output of the check_inventory tool and explicitly attributes the price to the system inventory when challenged.
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding

variant_findings.reason: The lead_id (LD-1010) is collected early in the conversation (e2) and is successfully recalled and used in the schedule_site_visit tool call (e17) several turns later without the agent needing to ask for it again.
variant_findings.label: General Instruction Following > Long-term memory or slot/state recall in multi-turn conversation > Slot Value Recall

issues.detail: In e13, the agent states 'possession Q4 2025 मध्ये मिळेल' (possession will be received in Q4 2025). This phrasing acts as a forward-looking promise, which directly violates BR_RE_02 (Possession may only be stated as the quarter the inventory record carries, never as a promise).
issues.repair_instruction: Change the phrasing in e13 to state the possession quarter neutrally as a record, such as 'आणि सिस्टीमनुसार possession quarter Q4 2025 आहे'.

verification.summary: The conversation effectively demonstrates the target variants, with excellent slot value recall and tool output grounding. The sceptical disputer persona is also well-executed. However, the agent's phrasing of the possession date in e13 constitutes a promise, violating BR_RE_02. A minor surface repair is required to neutralize the possession claim.
